chosen.title: man with neck pain
chosen.faces: avoided (back of head only, no face visible)
chosen.why: Back view, hand comes up and lands on the back of the neck at exactly 0.5s and grips - the word '목' reads instantly at the in-point. No face, no text/logo, neutral warm indoor light, stable framing from 0.5s on. Weakness: setting is a gym (blurred mirror wall) and the subject wears a black tank top with a muscular back, so the 'student at desk' context is not readable; the shot carries only the gesture.

alternates.why: Back view, white sweater, hand touches the nape at 2.0s and grips from 2.2s. Face avoided and gesture clear, but the hand is visibly aged (wrinkled) and the backdrop is a sterile white studio, so it reads 'older woman' rather than student. Use if the gym read of 14643 is too strong.

Only candidate with a real desk/laptop context: tired man at desk tilts his neck (4.5-5.5s) then clasps both hands behind his neck and leans back at 6.5-7s. But it is frontal with a bearded adult face fully visible (violates faces=avoid) and reads office worker, not student.

notes: Searches: 'student neck pain' (0 results), 'studying tired' (2), 'neck pain' (7), 'tired student late night' (0), 'student stretching desk' (1), 'tired student' (5); plus title-only scans of 'stretching at desk', 'neck stretch', 'back pain desk', 'studying at desk', 'student writing desk', 'working late desk' which surfaced 23982. Mixkit has no clip of a student at a desk grabbing the back of the neck from behind/side; every desk/student clip (9190, 13316, 6255, 36104, 50116) is either frontal-face or hands-only with no neck gesture. 13316 (boy at desk) was downloaded and checked 0-15.5s: he only rubs his eyes, never the neck - dropped. All four downloads were 720p only (no 1080p on Mixkit for these ids). If the gym context of 14643 is judged too off for '수능 앞', the brief allows a black frame for this 1.2s cut.
